feat(mobile): add printer status tips and continuous-paper advance (#126)

* feat(mobile): add printer status tips and continuous-paper advance

Listen after connect for paper-out and cover-open using framed DLE EOT
replies, and show a dismissible top-right tip. Drive print feed from
catalog paperModes, keep the selected protocol in sync, and advance
continuous jobs about 20 mm after the raster. Restore bundled home
banners when the public catalog is empty.

* feat(mobile): fit print jobs to paper and unify companion flows

Scale photos and scans down to A4 without stretching smaller images,
fit web captures and notes to the selected media, keep scanner
contrast local, and reconnect the last bonded printer on launch.

Also unifies 1-bit threshold/dither on the shared print preview,
adds Japanese locale, and generates AI print pages at printer size.

* fix(ci): pass format and clippy gates

Replace home-banner test expect() with panic mappings so clippy
-D warnings succeeds, and format Dart/Prettier files the check
workflow requires.

Also apply the 佳博打印机 display name and square G-mark icon.
